title: Egyptian Mung Bean Fritters
description: Crispy fritters filled with a flavorful mixture of mung beans, juicy sprouts, and spices.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine mung beans, sprouts, bean sprouts, and spices. Blend until well mixed.
In a large bowl, combine the blended mixture, flour, and water. Mix well.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the mixture into the pan and flatten slightly.
Cook for 3-4 minutes or until the fritters are golden brown and crispy.
Flip the fritters and cook for another 3-4 minutes.
Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
